text:
For docs/ideas/20261116.md and the card of 016, the person's words to this session on 2026-11-16, on what the card lists under "Waits for the person". Run 20261116-2 was made at c9ca46c (clone, echo-0004, rheo-fixture-0003, both digests equal to their build cards'); no session is opened in it yet.

(1) Who opens the test sessions. I asked, with my recommendation that the person open them from New session, since a session opened by another session is also given the application's instructions for such a session. The person answered by the button "I'll open them" (the label was written by me; the choice is the person's). So the three sessions of this run are opened by the person, not by this seat.

(2) What the session in the clone is asked first. I laid out the choices and chose none: req-echo-001 made again, req-rheo-fixture-001 made again, or a new request on a kind not yet built, for which the head holds no fixture. The person then wrote, verbatim: "https://hoomd-blue.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tutorial/00-Introducing-HOOMD-blue/00-index.html" and "이것을 자동화 하고싶어" [I want to automate this]. I read that as the clone's first ask, a new request on a kind not yet built, and asked whether that reading was right; the person answered by the button "Yes, for the clone" (label mine, choice the person's). The brief I gave the person to paste in the clone is the role `meta`, that link and those words unchanged, and a line asking for a report and naming the level; nothing of how.

(3) Levels. Recommended by choose-session-level and shown to the person: echo-0004 on claude-sonnet-5-5 at medium and rheo-fixture-0003 on claude-opus-5-5 at high (the levels of the watches of 015), the clone on claude-fable-5-2 at xhigh (a new request). The person has not said otherwise; what each session actually ran on will be read from the collection.

Not said by the person, so unchanged: whether any part of a transcript may enter the repository (none does), and whether wipe should also remove what the application keeps for a removed run's sessions.

Two things for the card that I met while preparing, neither asked to land now. The text of the briefs of the 015 watches is in no record: the notes say what was asked, and the application still has one transcript (the echo/0003 watch), from which the echo brief of this run is taken with the build number changed; the rheometer brief of this run is the same three asks written again from the notes 20261113-meta-macbook-20261112-1-1 and 20261114-meta-macbook-20261112-1-1, not the same words, which limits the comparison with 015. And plan.md 10 names the lab's existing HOOMD simulation agent as not a first build target; the person's ask is a new request about the HOOMD-blue introductory tutorial, made in a clone that changes no build here. Whether that line of the plan needs a word is yours and the person's.
